items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being urged to take AI governance seriously after Forrester recommended firms focus on practical, real-world AI policies rather than theoretical frameworks. Separately, experts warn that AI tools are helping cybercriminals attack older, unpatched systems faster than ever — a concern for organisations still running legacy technology. Meanwhile, local businesses are also being hit financially by expired or mismanaged digital certificates, with Australian firms losing over USD $250,000 on average when certificate failures cause outages or security incidents.

If your organisation uses AI tools like ChatGPT, be aware that conversations may be reviewed by humans for quality purposes — remind staff to never paste sensitive client or student information into these tools.

featured.title: Forrester urges firms to prioritise practical AI governance
